_comment: BCM 0x620 lamp output DIDs for UDS 0x2F InputOutputControl (force 2F <did> 03 01, release 2F <did> 00). Lamp NAMES: confirmed=seen on the truck; firmware_pair=the firmware blinks these two DIDs together as an L/R pair (extracted from the light-show code, ZES-128 word 0x5b7a); inferred=name guessed from pairing + the truck's tentative notes. The firmware's DID->name is NOT labelled in the binary, so names below are our best cross-reference of (truck observation) x (firmware L/R pairing) x (ZPU logical light list).
preconditions: ENGINE RUNNING (engine-off drops the 10 03 session). Responses drop on the busy bus - retry force until POSITIVE 6F.

0xD1B3.label: unknown (firmware pair A w/ center brake)

firmware_notes: The light show also drives 0xD0xx outputs on a DIFFERENT module (0x74A/0x74B) - NOT included here because this tool targets BCM 0x620 only. To confirm a firmware_pair/inferred name, iocontrol one DID (e.g. 0xD1B2) parked+running and watch which lamp lights; set confidence:confirmed when seen.
